target: Toolkit CPT fields as Elementor dynamic tag sources
objective: Verify that CPT fields created by the Toolkit are available as Elementor dynamic tag sources for filter field binding.
preconditions: A Toolkit CPT definition exists with at least one text field, one number field, one date field, one select/radio field, and one taxonomy.
The plugin registers a Toolkit dynamic tag group or equivalent field source provider.
steps: Create or load the Toolkit CPT definition.
Open a Filter Controller widget in Elementor.
Open dynamic tags for a filter field binding.
Select each Toolkit CPT field type.
Save the widget as a preset.
Reload and verify the selected field remains available and selected.
expected_result: Toolkit CPT fields appear as first-class, stable field sources for filters.
pass_criteria: Toolkit field source group is visible in Elementor.
meta field keys are selectable without relying on an active post context only.
selected keys are persisted into the preset and restored on reload.
evidence_required: Guilherme QA notes for editor usability
